name: CLEAN
description: CLEAN removes non-printable characters (character codes 0 through 31) from text, which commonly appear when importing data from other systems.
tldr: Strips non-printable control characters from text.

parameters.name: text
parameters.description: The text or cell reference from which to remove non-printable characters.

basicExample.explanation: CHAR(9) is a tab (a non-printable control character) that CLEAN strips, leaving "Data".

advancedExamples.title: Clean imported data
advancedExamples.scenario: Cell A1 has hidden line-feed characters from a CSV export
advancedExamples.explanation: Removing codes 0-31 prevents lookup mismatches caused by invisible characters.

advancedExamples.title: Combine with TRIM
advancedExamples.scenario: Data has both control chars and extra spaces
advancedExamples.explanation: CLEAN removes control characters, then TRIM collapses extra spaces.

howItWorks: CLEAN scans the string and deletes characters whose code points fall in the 0-31 control range. It does not remove printable characters or, by default, characters above 31.

howToSteps.name: Find dirty text
howToSteps.text: Locate cells with imported or copy-pasted text.

limitations: Only removes characters 0-31; it does not strip all Unicode control or format characters.
Excel 2016+ adds an optional second argument for cleaning additional character sets, but the classic form uses one argument.
Does not remove printable junk like extra spaces (use TRIM for that).

commonErrors.cause: CLEAN removed control chars but extra spaces remain.
commonErrors.fix: Wrap the result in TRIM as well: =TRIM(CLEAN(cell)).

googleSheetsEquivalent.description: Google Sheets CLEAN also removes codes 0-31 and additionally removes code 127 (DEL).
googleSheetsEquivalent.notes: Sheets removes a slightly broader set (also code 127) than legacy Excel.

faq.question: What characters does CLEAN remove?
faq.answer: Non-printable control characters with codes 0 through 31 (and code 127 in Google Sheets).

faq.question: Why combine CLEAN with TRIM?
faq.answer: CLEAN handles control characters; TRIM removes extra spaces so the text matches cleanly.

faq.question: Does CLEAN remove line breaks I want?
faq.answer: Yes, line feeds (code 10) are removed; if you need them, keep them before cleaning or substitute them back.
